scriptText:
I. BROKEN FRAME

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a raw 1990s 35mm film screen test interview featuring @image1 as ROSA, confronting sudden personal grief mid-shoot, supported briefly by @image2 as ROBERT, while questioned by @image3 as ARTHUR off-camera.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Maintain single-take continuity without cuts. Preserve spatial axis, naturalistic micro-performances, consistent key lighting, and grounded physical interactions between subjects.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 1990s 35mm film stock, organic grain, subtle halation
Palette: Slate blue, charcoal, muted cream, warm skin tones
Lighting: Soft directional key light camera-left, gentle warm rim light
Location: Minimalist soundstage, textured grey-blue backdrop, wooden stool
Wardrobe: Rosa wearing an oversized vintage olive-green ribbed knit sweater and dark pleated trousers; Robert wearing a charcoal unbuttoned chore jacket over a faded off-white henley shirt;
Audio: Pure diegetic soundstage room tone, foley, and dialogue; no music score
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
MCU, eye-level, static single shot centered on Rosa seated on a wooden stool against the dark slate backdrop, eyes glistening with suppressed emotion.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]



[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] MCU, eye-level -> [ACT] A dark crew silhouette crosses the blurred foreground -> [ACT] Rosa rubs her trembling knuckles -> <Muffled studio chatter and hurried footsteps>
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Rosa lifts her chin slightly -> Arthur (O.S.) says: {Whenever you remember her voice, what is the first thing that comes back?} -> [ACT] Rosa swallows hard, blinking rapidly -> <Distant equipment latch click>
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Rosa parts her lips with a shaky exhale -> Rosa says (voice trembling): {She never whispered.} -> [ACT] Rosa presses her hands firmly against her jeans -> <Soft fabric friction>
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Rosa looks down toward frame-left -> Rosa says: {Even when everything was quiet, she filled the entire hallway.} -> [ACT] Rosa bites her lower lip to hold back tears
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] A single tear slips down Rosa's cheek -> Rosa says: {We were supposed to call her at lunch.} -> [ACT] Rosa bows her head, shoulders trembling -> <Stifled sob>
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Robert enters frame-right, kneeling beside the stool -> [ACT] Robert places a steady hand on the stool rung, looking up at Rosa -> <Floorboard creak>
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Rosa turns her glistening eyes toward Robert -> Rosa says (whispering): {I didn't pick up the second ring.} -> [ACT] Rosa dabs her eye with the back of her wrist -> <Soft sniffle>
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Robert tilts his head gently with warm empathy -> Robert says (softly): {She knew, Rosa. Can you do this today?} -> [ACT] Rosa exhales deeply, meeting his gaze
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Rosa nods slowly, steeling her expression -> Rosa says: {I want to finish what we started.} -> [ACT] Robert gives a reassuring nod, squeezing her forearm -> <Soft fabric rustle>
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Robert stands and exits frame-right -> [ACT] Rosa straightens her spine and smooths down her sweater -> <Quiet receding footsteps>
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Rosa closes her eyes for one steady breath -> Rosa says: {She'd hate it if I stopped the roll.} -> [ACT] Rosa opens her focused eyes toward off-camera
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Rosa rolls her shoulders back -> Arthur (O.S.) says: {Take ten if you need, Rosa.} -> [ACT] Rosa raises her right hand slightly in a gentle decline -> <Soundstage ambient hum>
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Rosa tilts her head upward -> Rosa says: {No, don't cut.} -> [ACT] Rosa settles her posture with calm determination
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Rosa turns her gaze directly into the camera lens -> Rosa says: {Let's take it from the top.} -> [ACT] A subtle, resolute half-smile touches her lips
[CAM 01] -> [ACT] Rosa holds unwavering eye contact with the lens -> [ACT] Rosa releases a quiet, steady breath -> <Clapper slate snap in distance>
[</BRIEF>]
